hero.headline: From Interface Physics to Reliable Electronic Systems.
hero.description: I investigate how interfaces, defects, and electronic and ionic transport govern memory-state formation, device variability, and reliability. My research connects physical mechanisms with device engineering, electrical characterization, and array-level validation across semiconductor and emerging electronic platforms.

work.title: Research Work
work.headline: Physical mechanisms demonstrated in functional hardware.

features.title: Hydrogen-Bond Engineering for Precise and Reliable Analog Memory
features.description: PVA–CsPbI₃ hydrogen bonding suppresses interfacial traps and stabilizes linear, symmetric analog updates. A fabricated 7 × 7 crossbar and image-classification evaluation connect device physics to computation.
features.evidence: >8× lower interfacial trap density · ≈12.5 pJ/update · >10⁴ s at 85 °C

features.title: Helicity-Encoded Analog Memory with Array-Level Computing
features.description: Optical helicity conditions persistent, electrically readable conductance states. A PCB-integrated 7 × 7 array with ADC/FPGA readout validates mixed-signal vector–matrix multiplication.
features.evidence: 72 distinguishable states · 10⁶ s retention · PCB/ADC/FPGA readout

breadthParagraphs: My broader work spans memory devices, semiconductor interfaces, molecular electronics, photodetection, photovoltaics, and flexible electronics, with a recurring focus on transport, variability, and reliability.
work.journalStatement: First-author and collaborative research published in Advanced Materials, ACS Nano, Advanced Functional Materials, and other leading journals.

outlook.title: Research Outlook
outlook.headline: From Understanding Devices to Engineering Reliable Systems.
outlook.introduction: I aim to connect device physics with reliable memory, computing hardware, and integrated electronic systems.

directions.title: Predictive Memory Reliability
directions.description: Can read noise and stochastic state evolution reveal the origins of analog memory variability and anticipate reliability loss?

directions.title: Hardware-Aware Memory Computing
directions.description: How do switching variation and read noise propagate into array errors, and which device or peripheral choices can reduce them?

directions.title: Integrated & Adaptive Electronics
directions.description: How do interface defects and processing conditions govern leakage and long-term stability in advanced thin-film and capacitor structures?
